title: @Transactional silently ignored with spring-boot-starter-kafka on Spring Boot 4.0: 'No transaction is in process'
errorSample:
java.lang.IllegalStateException: No transaction is in process; possible solutions: run the template operation within the scope of a template.executeInTransaction() operation, start a transaction with @Transactional before invoking the template method, run in a transaction started by a listener container when consuming a record
	at org.springframework.util.Assert.state(Assert.java:80)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.getTheProducer(KafkaTemplate.java:975)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.doSend(KafkaTemplate.java:849)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.observeSend(KafkaTemplate.java:826)
	at org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate.send(KafkaTemplate.java:607)
	at task.OrderEventPublisher.publishAll(Application.kt:22)
	at task.OrderEventPublisherTests.발행한 이벤트는 커밋되어 모두 전송된다(OrderEventPublisherTests.kt:64)

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: With spring.kafka.producer.transaction-id-prefix set, calling KafkaTemplate.send from a @Transactional method throws IllegalStateException "No transaction is in process; possible solutions: ...". The @Transactional annotation is ignored without any error or warning.
cause: Boot 4 moved TransactionAutoConfiguration (which enables transaction management and the @Transactional proxies) into the spring-boot-transaction module, and spring-boot-starter-kafka does not pull that module in. KafkaTransactionManager is still auto-configured, but nothing creates the transactional proxies, so the method runs without a transaction.
fixSummary: Add the dependency org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-transaction (version managed by the Boot BOM). Equivalent alternatives: declare @EnableTransactionManagement on the application class, or add a starter that already includes the module such as spring-boot-starter-jdbc or spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Fixed upstream in 4.0.2.
